question: Why does water gush out of an artesian well with no pump?
answer: Water gushes out of an artesian well with no pump because it is trapped under pressure. Drilling opens a way out, and the pressure pushes the water up by itself.
move: Trapped water is pressurised water: open a way out and it climbs by itself.
